Allowlist for sidecar-only routes — routes the sidecar serves that no renderer file calls. Each entry must be classified as one of:
  - intentionalInternal: server-to-server / admin / health probe; never called from the renderer.
  - futureUi: route exists for an unbuilt panel; expected to gain a renderer caller soon.
  - deprecated: legacy route slated for removal.
The sidecar-routes-allowlist test fails when a NEW sidecar-only route appears that's not in any list. To clear, classify it here.
